references.title: DWDS: weil
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung; Konjunktion; Etymologie: from the noun mhd. wīle, no longer read

notes.rationale: weil seine Frau ..., because. DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word, and indeclinable, so it has no Ending, not even ∅ (ADR 0051): the Root weil alone.
